page_title: BOL 3-0 EMP | Bologna v Empoli 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' An attempted cross from Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) is cleared.
90+2' 3 - 0 Goal! Oussama El Azzouzi plays a simple square pass into the feet of Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball inside the left post. 3:0.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
88' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
86' Here is a change. Joshua Zirkzee is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna).
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Dan Ndoye walks off the pitch to be replaced by Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
86' The ball is cleared after Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
83' Wonderful movement by Empoli. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
81' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) receives a yellow card.
79' Francesco Caputo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Stiven Shpendi (Empoli).

78' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Fabio Maresca with no other option than to blow for a foul.
76' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
74' None of the Empoli players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
71' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
69' Substitution. Tommaso Baldanzi is replaced by Mattia Destro (Empoli).
69' Today's match ends for Liberato Cacace who will be replaced by Simone Bastoni (Empoli).
68' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Tommaso Corazza is replaced by Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Remo Freuler leaves the pitch and Michel Aebischer (Bologna) comes on.
66' 2 - 0 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
66' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) serves up a nice cross, but Lukasz Skorupski punches the ball away.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
62' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
59' Here comes a substitution. Filippo Ranocchia is given a rest as he is replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli).
59' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to make a change. Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) replaces Nicolo Cambiaghi.
58' Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Fabio Maresca had an easy-decision to make.
57' Empoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) replaces Nikola Moro.
53' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
48' Razvan Marin (Empoli) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
47' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) was quite harsh and Fabio Maresca didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli).
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

45' Etrit Berisha pulls off a great save to deny Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
44' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Tommaso Corazza (Bologna) is given a yellow card.
44' The current number of shots on goal is 2:3.
42' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
39' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
38' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Fabio Maresca blows for a foul.
37' The goal by Empoli is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
37' The Empoli players joy may have been justified, because referee Fabio Maresca is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
37' A goal, which was scored by Francesco Caputo (Empoli), was disallowed due to offside.
33' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

30' Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Lukasz Skorupski thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
27' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
24' A great pass puts Youssef Maleh (Empoli) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.

21' 1 - 0 Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Etrit Berisha is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
20' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
20' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the left post is smartly dealt with by Etrit Berisha.
18' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
17' It looks like Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) saw red with that tackle. Fabio Maresca won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
16' That was close by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
14' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
12' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
11' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
10' Yellow card. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
9' Empoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

8' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Lukasz Skorupski leaps like a salmon to deny him.
6' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

5' What a great chance for Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
4' The ball goes out of play. Empoli are awarded a corner kick.
2' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Empoli will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Fabio Maresca.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
